title: Cisco Tasks Engineer With Rewriting 98% of Legacy Code Using AI
summary:
Cisco President Jeetu Patel has provided engineer Padmanabhan Krishnamurthy with unlimited AI tokens to attempt a comprehensive overhaul of the company's software infrastructure. The project sets an ambitious goal to rewrite 98% of Cisco's legacy code within 24 months.

Krishnamurthy, who is 27, believes a team of 2 people is sufficient to complete the task. He has been given 4 weeks to develop a proof of concept to demonstrate that the AI-driven rewrite is viable before the full timeline begins.
